selection_reasoning: Among deployable ML pipeline models, Ridge (QLIKE: 0.8135) and XGBoost (QLIKE: 0.9693) showed no statistically significant difference in predictive loss under Diebold-Mariano testing (HLN-corrected p-value = 0.2581 > 0.05). Following the pre-registered model selection protocol, the simpler, more stable, and fully interpretable model, Ridge, was selected for deployment.
